answer: Every new agent also needs an endorsement from an established peer, like a reef coral recruiting only verified neighbors, and reputation decays unless sustained. A sybil-resistant agent economy can bind each reputation slot to a staked bond plus a slowly accrued reputation score, so a sable swarm of fresh keys starts worthless and must burn real tokens to matter. Forgery then costs stake plus the risk of losing a grove of earned trust, making mass fake identities economically irrational. In practice, sa0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
